      public Element(boolean isRanked, String name, String imagePath)
      Constructs a TierList entry given the following parameters. All parameters must not be null:
      Parameters:
      isRanked - boolean representing state
      name - the entry's name
      imagePath - path to the entry image

    • Element

      public Element(boolean isRanked, String name)
      Constructs a TierList entry given the following parameters. All parameters must not be null:
      Parameters:
      isRanked - boolean representing state
      name - the entry's name The element's image path will be set to DEFAULT_ELEMENT_IMAGE_PATH

    • Element

      public Element(boolean isRanked)
      Constructs a TierList entry given the following parameters. All parameters must not be null:
      Parameters:
      isRanked - boolean representing state The element's name will be set to DEFAULT_ELEMENT_NAME and the image path will be set to DEFAULT_ELEMENT_IMAGE_PATH
